bank.q: Which type holds true or false only?

bank.model: Primitives store the value directly, are never null (int, double, char, boolean). References store the address of an object on the heap and can be null (String, arrays, classes).

bank.q: Explain why Java is platform independent.
bank.model: Source compiles to bytecode, which any computer with a JVM can run, so the same program runs on every operating system.

bank.title: Mini project: Unit converter
bank.brief: Write a program that stores a temperature in Celsius as a double, converts it to Fahrenheit (C*9/5+32) and to Kelvin (C+273.15), and prints both with labels. Use a final constant for 273.15.
